title: Pure Radiant Typhoon
summary: Pure Radiant Typhoon WIND combo and control deck, built entirely around activating and recurring Mystical Space Typhoon. The archetype's Quick-Play Spells search MST or archetype monsters and Set themselves again from the GY when destroyed by MST, while high-level monsters swarm the field whenever any Quick-Play Spell is activated to overwhelm the opponent.

summary.title: Starters & Setup
points: Radiant Typhoon Eldam: Summons itself while MST is in GY or the opponent controls no backrow, searching a Radiant Typhoon monster or MST on summon.
Radiant Typhoon Swen: Special Summons itself under the same conditions and searches a Radiant Typhoon Spell or Trap or MST.
Radiant Typhoon Chant: Limited Normal Spell that adds a Level 4 or lower Radiant Typhoon monster or MST directly from Deck to hand.
Radiant Typhoon Ascendance: Quick-Play Spell that revives a Level 6 or lower Radiant Typhoon from the GY or searches MST.

summary.title: Opening Play
steps: Normal or Special Summon Radiant Typhoon Eldam to search Radiant Typhoon Swen from the Deck.
Special Summon Radiant Typhoon Swen and activate its effect to search Radiant Typhoon Mandate or Mystical Space Typhoon.
Activate Radiant Typhoon Manifestation or Chant to send a monster or search Radiant Typhoon Meghala.
Activate Mystical Space Typhoon targeting your own face-down Radiant Typhoon Quick-Play Spell, destroying it to trigger its effect and Set it right back onto the field.
Chain Radiant Typhoon Meghala or Krosea from hand to Special Summon itself upon the Quick-Play activation and recruit an additional Radiant Typhoon from the Deck.
Link into Radiant Typhoon Varuroon, the Marine Eidolon, placing Radiant Typhoon Mandate directly onto the field and turning opponent's monsters into Continuous Spells.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Radiant Typhoon Varuroon, the Marine Eidolon: Link-2 boss that searches MST, petrifies two monsters into Continuous Spells, and directly activates Mandate from Deck.
Radiant Typhoon Varuroon, the Vibrant Vortex: Level 8 threat that leaps onto the field during any Quick-Play activation and negates monster effects while MST is in GY.
Radiant Typhoon Fonix, the Great Flame: High-level monster that joins on Quick-Play activations to shuffle two opposing cards back into the Deck.
Dominus Purge: High-impact handtrap negating searches whose attribute restriction carries zero penalty in an all-WIND strategy.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mystical Space Typhoon: The foundational Quick-Play trigger enabling self-destruction combos, deck floating, and backrow removal.
Radiant Typhoon Mandate: Continuous Trap recycling 3 Quick-Play Spells for a fresh draw and negating cards whenever MST is activated.
Radiant Typhoon Manifestation & Radiant Typhoon Vision: Provide foolish burial setup and draw power while doubling as MST searchers.

allow.Dominus Purge: Trap from the page's combo lines; its lock stops DARK, WATER and FIRE monsters, and every Radiant Typhoon is WIND.
